answer: Locks are published in spiral, expire in wander, and quartz lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 121 aliases as a result needs 186 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 30 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
